scenes.text: Logs catch the fire. Alerts wake humans. Humans patch it... We've all lived this loop... Not anymore.
Introducing Sensors. Tara's runtime intelligence — observing itself, every cycle.
An observability engine, right next to the application. It reads its own runtime. It ranks its own work.
It reads telemetry. It ranks signals. It recommends fixes. Every line grounded in a real trace.
Tara has Sensors today... A JIRA webhook stuck on five hundreds... A streams search timing out... The Read tool burning tokens... All caught — before the alert fired.
Then Sensors stops just reporting. It opens research threads on its own. Files its own work.
And the engine itself becomes a product. Not just internal tooling. Something we ship.
And this is just the beginning... Next, every product gets one. The Dashboard... UPI... Breeze and all other stacks... An engine of its own, for each.
Every app on its own feedback loop. Software that improves itself. Cycle by cycle.
Try it in tara-dev. Powered by NeuroLink. Build what matters.
